description: Search events, optionally filtered by keyword, city, classification name, and start time.

keyword.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match in event names.

city.description: Optional city name to restrict events to venues in that city.

classificationName.description: Optional classification name (segment, genre, or subgenre) to filter by.

startDateTime.description: Optional ISO datetime lower bound; only events at or after are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a page-wrapped object with _embedded.events and page metadata; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single event by id.

event_id.description: The id of the event to fetch.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the event object; on failure (event not found), output contains an error message.

description: Search venues, optionally filtered by keyword matching name or city.

keyword.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match in venue name or city.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a page-wrapped object with _embedded.venues and page metadata; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single venue by id.

venue_id.description: The id of the venue to fetch.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the venue object; on failure (venue not found), output contains an error message.

description: Search attractions, optionally filtered by keyword matching the name.

keyword.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match in attraction names.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a page-wrapped object with _embedded.attractions and page metadata; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single attraction by id.

attraction_id.description: The id of the attraction to fetch.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the attraction object; on failure (attraction not found), output contains an error message.

description: List all classifications with their nested genre and subgenre structure.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a page-wrapped object with _embedded.classifications and page metadata; on failure, output contains an error message.
